key_decisions: THE PREVIEW CONTRACT is a standing constraint on the whole MPI-424 set: every tool is visited, previewed, then applied - or the preview goes away. ONE seam: mountOptions() calls viewer.el.discardPreview() unconditionally and the viewer decides what to drop. MPI-382 built it; MPI-368 and MPI-373 hang their own previews on it and do NOT re-decide it.

AGENTS DO NOT EDIT WORKFLOW JSON. The user edits comfy_workflows/raw/ by hand; the agent produces the LIST and runs the sync afterwards. He holds per-node judgement an audit cannot encode - on MPI-431 he kept contour_fill on nodes that need it, kept mask_expand_pixels at 6, and overrode a leave-alone call on klein_t2i #290. A runtime-file list was rejected outright; raw/ is what he wants, with widget INDEX since LiteGraph has no named keys.

klein_t2i #290 GrowMaskWithBlur: the user turned its fill_holes off after it was listed leave-alone, and confirmed. expand stays 32. This makes node 286's mask_fill_holes: false real rather than cosmetic - #290 sits between the user mask and #286, so the fill had previously already happened one node upstream.
mask_expand_pixels: 6 stays on all six InpaintCropImproved by the user's decision. Revisit ONLY if an Adjust shrink reads as swallowed.
Fill fills what is ON SCREEN - the live preview when one is up - so it bakes a pending adjustment as ONE undo entry rather than silently dropping the user's preview.
constraints: MPI-426 is NOT closeable and two consecutive handoffs wrongly suggested it might be. MPI-382's preview contract fixed the leave-the-tool half only; dispatching while STILL in Detect keeps injecting the un-Added pick, because MaskManager._recomposite() still unions selected picks into maskCanvas and getURL() still reads maskCanvas. Verified in source 2026-08-03 and written onto the card. It also OWES MPI-372 a replacement unlock signal - the op strip must unlock on 'a detection exists', not 'maskCanvas has pixels'.

Mask/paint layer mutations are UNDOABLE. The complete set is enumerated in docs/masking-undo.md - paint(), clear(), bakeAutoPicksInto(), applyAdjust(), fillHoles(). An unwired mutation is a silent hole in Ctrl+Z.

Every new mask tool registers in _MASK_TOOLS, TOOL_OPTIONS_REGISTRY, TOOL_LABELS, the MpiHistoryTools group, js/shell/preloadStyles.js and js/components/types.js. MpiCanvas._methods is an ALLOWLIST and a missing name is undefined on el - which the optional-call idiom in the panels makes completely silent.

A class with `display` OUTRANKS the UA sheet's `[hidden] { display: none }`. That is how three slider rows ended up on screen when only one was live. Any panel hiding a row by attribute needs its own `[hidden]` rule.
Tests run as node --test with the quoted glob "tests/*.test.cjs". The directory form dies on Node v24. Suite is at 324/0.

Working tree is CRLF - a Node replace using a literal newline escape silently misses. Assert a sabotage APPLIED before trusting a negative control; seven fired this session, all restored byte-identical.

Source-text tests cannot prove pixel logic. The real-pixel route is a temp module under js/ served same-origin off the running :3000, imported in Chromium via playwright-cli, deleted after. That is what caught the seam and what proved the outer edge does not move.

Board mutation: load and format-detect EVERY file first, then write - with a round-trip guard that re-serialises the UNMUTATED parse and demands byte equality. A done move must ALSO set status: done. validate_board.py's resting state is 416 violations, so judge the DELTA, never the exit code.
